cards.plain_question: When a meeting moved from Wednesday, did it move to Monday or Friday?
cards.contrast: moved-earlier means before the old time; moved-later means after it
cards.example: The Wednesday review moved-earlier to Monday.
cards.trap: The marker gives direction, not the new date unless the sentence also supplies it.
cards.evidence_lane: advance; settle the four comparator-specific comprehension originals and add tag fidelity

cards.plain_question: Does the task need at least one reviewer, or one reviewer and no more?
cards.contrast: one-or-more sets only a lower bound; exactly-one sets both lower and upper bounds
cards.trap: The count applies to the bounded action instance, not every future approval.
cards.evidence_lane: advance when the two-lineage reader gate clears

cards.plain_question: Is this list merely a list of examples, or the complete list?
cards.contrast: among-others withholds completeness; and-no-others asserts closure
cards.trap: among-others does not itself assert that an omitted member exists.
cards.evidence_lane: repair then decide; retain the confirmed current-token cost as opposing evidence

cards.plain_question: Does may grant permission, or merely say something could happen?
cards.contrast: may-as-permission authorises; may-as-possibility forecasts an open possibility
cards.example: may-as-permission: the agent may publish the report.
cards.trap: Possibility does not grant authority, and permission does not predict occurrence.
cards.evidence_lane: repair the served contract and low-floor instrument before more spend

cards.plain_question: Could every member satisfy the claim, or must at least one member fail it?
cards.contrast: some-or-all permits all; some-but-not-all requires both a satisfying and a non-satisfying member
cards.trap: Neither form says whether the named set is the whole population or only a sample.
cards.evidence_lane: repair or retire; preserve the near-null original and strongly adverse replication

cards.plain_question: Is the reported set the complete population, or only a subset?
cards.contrast: whole makes population-level absence and rates available; part limits them to a subset
cards.trap: The marker states coverage, not confidence, observation quality, or quantifier force.
cards.evidence_lane: showcase with explanation only; a third independent carrier must settle the dispute

cards.plain_question: When a sentence names two things and then says it, which thing does it mean?
cards.contrast: the parameter explicitly names the earlier referent
cards.example: The robot moved the crate because it(crate) blocked the door.
cards.trap: The marker binds a pronoun only; it does not assert causality, responsibility, identity, or ownership.
cards.evidence_lane: newly proposed pipeline candidate; independent seconds and evidence still required

cards.plain_question: Does all are not mean zero satisfy the predicate, or merely fewer than all?
cards.contrast: none-of fixes the satisfying count at zero; not-all-of permits zero through N minus one
cards.trap: not-all-of permits zero healthy replicas; use some-but-not-all when at least one must be healthy.
cards.evidence_lane: newly proposed pipeline candidate; independent seconds and evidence still required

claim_boundary: Editorial pass means suitable for concise human-facing explanation. It is not measured comprehension, human validation, evidence support, ratification, or adoption.
